metadata.title: Babylon 5 Universe — DoraMCU Format Database
metadata.description: Complete character, race, storyline, and dialogue database from Babylon 5 (1993-1998), formatted for DoraMCU game integration.
metadata.source: Babylon 5 TV series created by J. Michael Straczynski

races.name: Human / Earth Alliance
races.description: The dominant species of the Earth Alliance. Humans are adaptable, ambitious, and technologically advanced. They built the Babylon stations as peacekeeping outposts.
races.government: Earth Alliance (democratic, later authoritarian under Clark)
races.combatStyle: Versatile — uses EarthForce military doctrine with advanced weaponry

races.name: Narn
races.description: A proud, resilient species from the Narn sector. Scarred by decades of Centauri occupation, the Narn are driven by a desire for freedom and justice. Short, stocky, and muscular with distinctive facial ridges.
races.homeworld: Narn (destroyed; now live on Narn 3 / Narn Regime worlds)
races.combatStyle: Aggressive close-quarters combat; guerrilla warfare expertise

races.name: Centauri
races.description: A decadent, aristocratic species from the Centauri Republic. Tall, elegant, and obsessed with status and pleasure. Historically expansionist and imperialistic, later humbled by war.
races.government: Centauri Republic (oligarchy, later empire under Londo Mollari)
races.combatStyle: Relies on wealth and political influence; declining military capability

races.name: Minbari
races.description: A spiritually advanced, long-lived species. The Minbari are guided by religious orders and possess technology far beyond most races. They have a caste system based on warrior, worker, and caster roles.
races.combatStyle: Disciplined military with advanced energy weapons and ships

races.name: Vorlon
races.description: Ancient, immensely powerful First Ones who guide younger races through order and obedience. Their true form is unknown; they wear encounter suits. They believe evolution requires discipline and hierarchy.
races.combatStyle: Overwhelming technological superiority; rarely fight directly

races.name: Shadow
races.description: Ancient, immensely powerful First Ones who believe evolution requires conflict and chaos. Massive, reptilian beings who manipulate younger races into war. They consider themselves gardeners of civilization.
races.combatStyle: Instigate proxy wars; deploy massive war fleets when direct action needed

races.name: Drazi
races.description: Large, bird-like humanoids with a warrior culture. Known for their enmity with the Centauri over border territories. Part of the League of Non-Aligned Worlds.

races.name: Vree
races.description: Small, rodent-like traders and merchants. Known for their love of food and commerce. Part of the League of Non-Aligned Worlds.
races.combatStyle: Avoid direct combat; rely on wealth and alliances

races.name: Hyach
races.description: Large, gentle, elephantine humanoids. Known for their peaceful nature and strength. Part of the League of Non-Aligned Worlds.

races.name: Brakiri
races.description: Nocturnal, bat-like humanoids with distinctive bone ridges. Part of the League of Non-Aligned Worlds. Known for their spiritual beliefs.

races.name: Pak'ma'ra
races.description: Large, multi-limbed beings with tentacled faces. Originally a peaceful race, many were transformed into warriors by the Shadows. Slow but powerful.

races.name: Drakh
races.description: The most ruthless faction of the Shadows. Remnant forces that survived the Shadow War and seek revenge. Led by Refan, they are even more dangerous than the original Shadows.

races.name: Lorien / First Ones
races.description: Ancient beings who created the First Ones. Lorien is the last of his kind, a being of immense power who aids Sheridan in the Shadow War. Represents the original creators of the galaxy.

characters.name: John Sheridan
characters.role: Commander, later President of the Interstellar Alliance
characters.description: Central protagonist. A brilliant military commander who becomes the leader of the alliance against the Shadows and later the first President of the new Interstellar Alliance. Charismatic, decisive, and driven by a vision of peace.
characters.storyArc: Military officer → Station commander → Shadow War leader → President of the Interstellar Alliance
famousQuotes: We are all alone now, just the younger races. We can't blame anyone else from now on. It's a new age, Delenn. A third age!
Now get the hell out of our galaxy!
We are here to place President Clark under arrest.
Do you always worry when things are going well?
I'm not going to let you destroy everything we've built.

characters.name: Susan Ivanova
characters.role: Executive Officer of Babylon 5, later commander
characters.description: The fiercely loyal and competent second-in-command of Babylon 5. Russian-born, she values her work above all else. Her tragic backstory and unwavering dedication make her one of the most compelling characters.
characters.storyArc: Station XO → Shadow War veteran → Narrator of the new age
famousQuotes: I don't have time to worry about them when they're not [going well].
The Babylon project was our last, best hope for peace. It failed. But in the year of the Shadow war it became something greater: our last, best hope for victory.
It was the year everything changed.

characters.name: Delenn
characters.role: Minbari Ambassador, later military leader
characters.description: A Minbari ambassador who undergoes a physical transformation as she embraces her destiny. She bridges the gap between the Minbari religious orders and the younger races. Her journey from diplomat to warrior is central to the series.
characters.storyArc: Minbari ambassador → Transformed being → Military leader → Sheridan's partner
famousQuotes: Now we make our own magic. Now we create our own legends. Now we build the future. Now we stop... being afraid of shadows.
Perhaps, but not today.
It was the end of one chapter, and the beginning of another.

characters.name: G'Kar
characters.role: Narn Ambassador, later religious figure
characters.description: A Narn ambassador who survived the Centauri torture camps. His journey from bitter revolutionary to spiritual leader is one of the most compelling arcs in the series. He carries the weight of his people's suffering.
characters.storyArc: Torture survivor → Ambassador → Revolutionary leader → Religious figure → Exile
famousQuotes: I have a very bad feeling about this.
The Centauri are a dying race. They have forgotten what it means to be proud.
I am G'Kar of Narn, and I will not be forgotten.

characters.name: Londo Mollari
characters.role: Centauri Ambassador, later Emperor
characters.description: A charming, witty Centauri ambassador whose Faustian bargain with the Shadows leads to his rise as Emperor and the destruction of his homeworld. One of the most tragic and complex characters in the series.
characters.storyArc: Charming ambassador → Shadow puppet → Emperor → Tragic figure destroyed by his own ambition
famousQuotes: I am still Centauri, and I am not afraid.
The universe is an endless series of battles between those who want to rule and those who don't want to be ruled.
Stop eating that! You don't even know what it is.

characters.name: Michael Garibaldi
characters.role: Head of Security, later underground resistance fighter
characters.description: The cynical, tough head of security on Babylon 5. A former cop with a drinking problem, he becomes a key figure in the resistance against President Clark's authoritarian regime.
characters.storyArc: Station security chief → Framed and exiled → Underground resistance leader → Married to Lise
famousQuotes: The year is 2261.
I've been in this business long enough to know that when something sounds too good to be true, it usually is.

characters.name: Jeffrey Sinclair
characters.role: First Station Commander of Babylon 5, later President of the Minbari Federation
characters.description: The idealistic first commander of Babylon 5. A diplomat at heart, he discovers his destiny as a prophesied leader of the Minbari. His journey bridges the human and Minbari storylines.
characters.storyArc: Station commander → Prophesied Minbari leader → President of the Minbari Federation
famousQuotes: The place: Babylon 5.
I believe that the universe is a place of infinite possibility.

characters.name: Stephen Franklin
characters.role: Chief Medical Officer of Babylon 5
characters.description: The compassionate chief medical officer who deals with the psychological and physical trauma of the station's crew. His relationship with Lyta Alexander adds depth to his character.
characters.storyArc: Station CMO → Head of xenobiology on Earth
famousQuotes: I'm a doctor, not a miracle worker.

characters.name: Lyta Alexander
characters.role: Telepath, mother of the Shadow/Minbari hybrid child
characters.description: A powerful telepath who carries the child of the new age — a hybrid of Shadow and Minbari DNA. Her journey from broken telepath to mother and leader of the telepath refugees is central to the series.
characters.storyArc: Broken telepath → Mother of the new age → Exile with G'Kar
famousQuotes: I'm not broken. I'm just... different.

characters.name: Alfred Bester
characters.role: Psi Corps commander, antagonist
characters.description: The ruthless head of the Psi Corps who will stop at nothing to maintain control over telepaths. A chilling villain who represents the darkest side of institutional power.
characters.lastAppearance: Season 4, Episode 20 ('The Deconstruction of Falling Stars')
characters.storyArc: Psi Corps commander → Corrupt enforcer → Destroyed by his own hubris
famousQuotes: The Psi Corps serves the Earth Alliance. That is all that matters.

characters.name: Vir Cotto
characters.role: Londo Mollari's attendant, later Prime Minister
characters.description: Londo Mollari's loyal, nervous attendant who evolves into a capable politician. His friendship with G'Kar is one of the most touching relationships in the series.
characters.storyArc: Nervous attendant → Prime Minister → Murdered by Prime Candidates
famousQuotes: I'm just a simple attendant.
Londo, please. Think before you act.

characters.name: Elizabeth Lochley
characters.role: Station Commander of Babylon 5 (Season 5)
characters.description: A strict, by-the-book military officer who becomes the station commander in Season 5. She represents the new generation of leaders who must maintain the Alliance.
characters.firstAppearance: Season 4, Episode 1 ('War Without End, Part One')
characters.storyArc: Military officer → Station commander → Guardian of the new Alliance
famousQuotes: I will not let this station fall.

characters.name: Lennier
characters.role: Delenn's attendant, later military officer
characters.description: Delenn's loyal attendant who evolves into a capable military officer. His unwavering devotion to Delenn and the Minbari cause makes him a steadfast character.
characters.storyArc: Attendant → Military officer → Delenn's trusted aide
famousQuotes: I serve Delenn, and through her, the Minbari.

characters.name: Kosh Naranek
characters.role: Vorlon Ambassador to Babylon 5
characters.description: The enigmatic Vorlon ambassador who communicates through a massive, mysterious encounter suit. His true intentions are unclear, but he guides the younger races toward independence.
characters.storyArc: Vorlon ambassador → Withdraws before Shadow War → Legacy of guidance
famousQuotes: The Vorlon way is the way of order and obedience.
You are not ready for the truth.

characters.name: Byron
characters.role: Rogue telepath, leader of telepath refugees
characters.description: A charismatic rogue telepath who leads a group of telepath refugees seeking asylum. Unlike Bester, he genuinely wants what's best for his people and is a committed pacifist.
characters.firstAppearance: Season 5, Episode 1 ('The Sword of Damocles, Part One')
characters.storyArc: Rogue telepath → Refugee leader → Tragic sacrifice
famousQuotes: We just want to live in peace.

characters.name: Mr. Morden
characters.role: Shadow agent, manipulator of Londo Mollari
characters.description: A Shadow agent who appears as a human businessman. He manipulates Londo Mollari into serving the Shadows, making him one of the most dangerous villains in the series.
characters.storyArc: Shadow agent → Londo's corruptor → Instrument of the Shadow War
famousQuotes: The Shadows offer you power, Londo. Power to reshape your world.

characters.name: Zathras
characters.role: Mysterious alien connected to Babylon 4
characters.description: An alien of unknown origin who is central to the disappearance of Babylon 4. His cryptic messages and connection to the station's fate make him one of the most mysterious characters.
characters.storyArc: Mysterious figure → Key to Babylon 4's return → Resolution of the Babylon mystery
famousQuotes: I am Zathras. I have been waiting for you.
Babylon 4 is not lost. It is waiting.

characters.name: Zack Allan
characters.role: Security officer, later station security chief
characters.description: A young, ambitious security officer who rises through the ranks. His loyalty to the station and growth into a capable leader make him a valuable character.
characters.storyArc: Security officer → Station security chief → Guardian of Babylon 5
famousQuotes: I'll keep this station safe.

characters.name: Marcus Cole
characters.role: Peacekeeper defector, warrior
characters.description: A former Peacekeeper who defects after discovering the truth about the Shadows. A skilled warrior with a strong moral compass.
characters.storyArc: Peacekeeper → Defector → Warrior against the Shadows
famousQuotes: I won't let them win.

characters.name: Lorien
characters.role: Last of the First Ones, ally of Sheridan
characters.description: The last of the ancient Lorien race, who created the First Ones. He aids Sheridan at a critical moment in the Shadow War, providing the technology and knowledge needed to defeat the Shadows.
characters.lastAppearance: Season 4, Episode 15 ('The Passing of the Technomancer')
characters.storyArc: Last of his kind → Sheridan's ally → Sacrifices himself to help defeat the Shadows
famousQuotes: Do you have anything worth living for?
It is a great responsibility. This is yours now.

storylines.title: The Shadow War
storylines.description: The central conflict of the series. The ancient Shadows and Vorlons have been manipulating younger races for millions of years. The Shadows believe evolution requires conflict; the Vorlons believe it requires order. Sheridan and the younger races rebel against both.

chapters.title: The Gathering
chapters.description: Babylon 5 opens. The station's first commander, Jeffrey Sinclair, discovers the station's true purpose as a meeting point for the great powers. The Shadows and Vorlons begin their game.

chapters.title: The Long Shadow
chapters.description: Sheridan takes command. The truth about the Shadows emerges. Londo Mollari makes his Faustian bargain. The Narn-Centauri war escalates.

chapters.title: The Fire
chapters.description: The Shadow War begins in earnest. Sheridan builds an alliance of younger races. The Earth government slides toward dictatorship under President Clark.

chapters.title: The Endgame
chapters.description: The Shadow War reaches its climax. Sheridan defeats the Shadows. The Vorlons withdraw. The younger races must now stand on their own.

storylines.title: Earth's Descent into Dictatorship
storylines.description: Parallel to the Shadow War, Earth slides from democracy to authoritarianism under President Clark. The Psi Corps becomes a tool of oppression. Garibaldi leads the underground resistance.

chapters.title: The Seeds of Tyranny
chapters.description: President Clark begins consolidating power. The Psi Corps expands its reach. Garibaldi is framed and exiled.

chapters.title: The Underground
chapters.description: Garibaldi builds a resistance movement. The telepath underground grows. Sheridan discovers the truth about Earth.

chapters.title: The Mars Conflict
chapters.description: Mars declares independence. Sheridan must choose between Earth and justice. The conflict is resolved through diplomacy and force.

storylines.title: The Telepath Crisis
storylines.description: Telepaths face extinction and persecution. The Psi Corps' abuse leads to a telepath underground. Lyta Alexander carries the child of the new age — a hybrid that could save or destroy telepaths.

chapters.title: The Psi Corps
chapters.description: The Psi Corps' abuse of telepaths is revealed. Lyta is broken by Bester. The underground begins to form.

chapters.title: The Child
chapters.description: Lyta discovers she is pregnant with a Shadow/Minbari hybrid. The child's fate will determine the future of telepaths.

chapters.title: The Refugee Crisis
chapters.description: Telepath refugees seek asylum on Babylon 5. Byron leads them. The Psi Corps hunts them down.

storylines.title: The Centauri Tragedy
storylines.description: Londo Mollari's rise to power and the destruction of Centauri Prime. A Faustian tale of ambition, betrayal, and the cost of power.

chapters.title: The Ambassador
chapters.description: Londo arrives at Babylon 5 as a charming, witty ambassador. His deal with the Shadows sets him on a path of destruction.

chapters.title: The Rise
chapters.description: Londo's influence grows. He manipulates events to gain power. Vir remains his loyal friend.

chapters.title: The Emperor
chapters.description: Londo becomes Emperor of the Centauri Republic. But the cost is the destruction of his homeworld by the Drakh.

storylines.title: The Narn Redemption
storylines.description: G'Kar's journey from bitter torture survivor to spiritual leader. The Narn people's struggle for freedom and justice.

chapters.title: The Survivor
chapters.description: G'Kar arrives at Babylon 5 as a bitter survivor of Centauri torture. His hatred of Mollari drives him.

chapters.title: The Revolutionary
chapters.description: G'Kar becomes a leader of the Narn resistance. He works with Sheridan to free the Narn from Centauri oppression.

chapters.title: The Prophet
chapters.description: G'Kar discovers he has become a religious figure. Unable to stay anywhere, he exiles himself with Lyta.

storylines.title: The Minbari Spiritual Journey
storylines.description: Delenn's transformation from diplomat to warrior and her role in bridging the Minbari and human worlds. The Minbari civil war and spiritual crisis.

chapters.title: The Ambassador
chapters.description: Delenn arrives as Minbari ambassador. She discovers the truth about the Minbari religious orders and her own destiny.

chapters.title: The Transformation
chapters.description: Delenn undergoes a physical transformation, becoming the bridge between Minbari and human. She embraces her warrior side.

chapters.title: The Leader
chapters.description: Delenn leads the Minbari through the Shadow War and beyond. She becomes Sheridan's partner in building the new Alliance.

dialogue.speaker: SHERIDAN
dialogue.line: We are all alone now, just the younger races. We can't blame anyone else from now on. It's a new age, Delenn. A third age!

dialogue.speaker: DELN
dialogue.line: Why third?

dialogue.speaker: SHERIDAN
dialogue.line: We begun in chaos, too primitive to make our own decisions. Then we were manipulated from outside by forces that thought they knew what was best for us. And now — now we are finally standing on our own. Lorien was right, it's a great responsibility. This is ours now.

dialogue.speaker: DELN
dialogue.line: Strange. The galaxy seems somehow smaller now that the First Ones are gone forever.

dialogue.speaker: SHERIDAN
dialogue.line: It feels like the magic's gone now.

dialogue.speaker: DELN
dialogue.line: No, not gone. Now we make our own magic. Now we create our own legends. Now we build the future. Now we stop... being afraid of shadows.

dialogue.speaker: SHERIDAN
dialogue.line: I apologize. I'm sorry. I'm sorry we had to defend ourselves against an unwarranted attack. I'm sorry that your crew was stupid enough to fire on a station filled with a quarter million civilians, including your own people. And I'm sorry I waited as long as I did before I blew them all straight to hell. As with everything else, it's the thought that counts.

dialogue.speaker: GKAR
dialogue.line: 'Some must be sacrificed for all to be saved.' First I took that as a revelation for the future. Now I see that it is as much about how we got here as about where we are going. I think that one sentence is the greatest burden I have ever known.

dialogue.speaker: DELN
dialogue.line: You are right, nothing would've been changed. Except that my people would now be a dead race.

dialogue.speaker: DELN
dialogue.line: You have come a long way, G'Kar. Further than I would've guessed. Sheridan's promise binds me as well it does him. We will take you into the Council, G'Kar. And someday, when all this is over, perhaps you will find it in your heart to forgive me.

dialogue.speaker: GKAR
dialogue.line: Perhaps, but not today.

dialogue.speaker: SHERIDAN
dialogue.line: Do you always worry when things are going well?

dialogue.speaker: IVANOVA
dialogue.line: I don't have time to worry about them when they're not.

dialogue.speaker: IVANOVA
dialogue.line: The Babylon project was our last, best hope for peace. It failed. But in the year of the Shadow war it became something greater: our last, best hope for victory. The year is 2260, the place: Babylon 5.

dialogue.speaker: DELN
dialogue.line: It was the end of the Earth year 2261. It was the dawn of a new age for all of us. It was the end of one chapter, and the beginning of another. The next twenty years would see great changes, great joy, great sorrow. The telepath war. The Drakh war. The new Alliance would waver and crack. In the end, it would hold — because what is built endures. And what is loved endures. And Babylon 5... Babylon 5 endures.

dialogues.title: Lorien's Question
dialogues.scene: Whatever Happened to Mr Garibaldi, Season 5

dialogue.speaker: LORIEN_B5
dialogue.line: Do you have anything worth living for?

dialogue.speaker: SHERIDAN
dialogue.line: Now get the hell out of our galaxy!

dialogue.speaker: SHERIDAN
dialogue.line: We are here to place President Clark under arrest.

dialogues.title: Delenn and Sheridan — Business or Pleasure
dialogues.scene: Movements of Fire and Shadow, Season 3

dialogue.speaker: DELN
dialogue.line: Something's bothering you. What is it?

dialogue.speaker: SHERIDAN
dialogue.line: I need to ask you to do something I don't want to ask you to do.

dialogue.speaker: DELN
dialogue.line: If it's about me wearing those little-- I appreciate the gift and I didn't say I wouldn't wear them, I just said that for me, from a Minbari perspective, I thought that it looked silly.

dialogue.speaker: SHERIDAN
dialogue.line: No, it's not anything to do with that.

dialogue.speaker: DELN
dialogue.line: Business then?

locations.name: Babylon 5
locations.description: The primary setting of the series. A massive space station built as a peacekeeping outpost and meeting point for all races. Located in neutral space.
locations.significance: Central hub of the series; where all storylines converge

locations.name: Earth
locations.description: Homeworld of humanity and capital of the Earth Alliance. Site of the authoritarian government under President Clark.

locations.name: Mars
locations.description: The red planet, a colony of Earth that declares independence during the Clark regime.
locations.significance: Site of the Mars independence conflict

locations.name: Minbar
locations.description: Homeworld of the Minbari. A spiritually advanced world with towering cities and deep religious significance.
locations.significance: Minbari capital; site of the Minbari civil war

locations.name: Centauri Prime
locations.description: Homeworld of the Centauri. A decadent world of pleasure and politics. Destroyed by the Drakh in the series finale.
locations.significance: Centauri capital; destroyed as punishment for Shadow War complicity

locations.name: Narn 3 (Narn Regime)
locations.description: The new homeworld of the Narn people after their original world was destroyed by the Centauri.

locations.name: Babylon 4
locations.description: The previous Babylon station that disappeared into the Shadow dimension. Its return is a key plot point.
locations.significance: Mystery of the missing station; connection to Zathras

locations.name: Skarrin
locations.description: A world that becomes the site of the new Interstellar Alliance headquarters.
